verdict.rationale: MoonPay's docs reference generating type-safe API clients from an OpenAPI specification (moonpay-docs-28), implying a machine-readable spec exists, but a hands-on probe of the standard OpenAPI file locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 for all candidates, meaning no publicly downloadable spec could be located (moonpay-probe-2). This is a direct contradiction between vendor claim and hands-on verification. missing for 10: a working public URL for the OpenAPI/swagger file, independent confirmation that the spec is actually downloadable.
